integrity: The continuum reduction is analytic, using convexity on products of boundary edges. The bundled verifier certifies the finite facet-matrix enumeration, determinant identities, sharp eigenvector, and parameter-maximum algebra. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is a complete two-parameter computation for one canonical two-dimensional hexagonal norm; it does not classify arbitrary Day–James spaces or higher-dimensional polyhedral Banach spaces. The balanced specialization is classical and is not claimed as a new isolated value.
title: Exact Euler–Lagrange profile of the affine-regular hexagonal plane
